definitions.dcg: sum(gain_at_rank_i/log2(i+1)), i starts at 1; linear gain (no 2**gain transform)
definitions.ideal: Sort all legal successor candidates by map distance, keep min(10,N).
definitions.current: Exclude current from the ranked retrieval items; only successor candidates are scored.
definitions.ties: Average gain across each predicted tie group, including cutoff-straddling ties.
definitions.malformed: Malformed or absent ranking scores 0 when candidates exist.
definitions.partial: Missing ranks contribute zero; a parseable wrong top-10 set is scored by its actual gains.
definitions.no_candidates: NDCG undefined, excluded and counted separately.
definitions.cohorts: all: all nonterminal turns with candidates, including already-unreachable states; solvable: remaining_shortest >= 1.
definitions.aggregation: Unweighted mean across eligible decision turns; each step uses its actual surviving cases.
definitions.random: Exact expected NDCG for a uniformly random permutation of all legal candidates; full top-k, no format errors.

definitions.gain: K=min(10,N); map ranks 1..K receive linear grades K..1; ranks >K receive 0.
definitions.true_ties: Map-distance ties (rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-12) receive the mean grade of their occupied ordinal slots, including zeros beyond K.
